'''Prahman Su''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who was considered one of the most disreputable scoundrels in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Su became friends and rivals with fellow scoundrel [[Brali Ixxis]] when the pair worked together on a [[clotheslegging]] job near the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]], which they mutually botched. The pair then began running semi-regular games of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on Su's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], which became known as [[Ixxis and Su's Floating Game]]. A game would begin whenever the pair both found themselves in the [[City/Legends|city]] at the same time and would then move from location to location. Players who wished to enter required a personal invite from Ixxis or Su, as well as a 5000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] initial stake. The game attracted large numbers of up and coming [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] and card sharks, although those without the necessary money where beaten an robbed upon arrival.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prahman Su was first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system. The book does not make clear Su's gender.
